evals.name: validate-actual-lesson-file
evals.prompt: Check my data/module1-lessons.json to make sure all the Malayalam content is pure Malayalam script with no accidental Tamil, Arabic, or other scripts mixed in.
evals.expected_output: Report showing validation results - either confirming no issues or listing any non-Malayalam characters found with location and context

evals.name: validate-specific-lesson
evals.prompt: I just edited lesson 1.0 about vowels. Can you verify that only Malayalam script is used in the character descriptions?
evals.expected_output: Focused validation on lesson 1.0, confirming Malayalam purity or reporting issues

evals.name: check-character-fields
evals.prompt: Validate that the 'malayalam' character fields in my lessons only contain Malayalam Unicode, nothing else.
evals.expected_output: Targeted check of Malayalam character fields, confirming no non-Malayalam script
